title: Docs convention: write versionadded/versionchanged as backtick-fenced MyST directives in docs/*.md

note.title: Docs convention: write versionadded/versionchanged as backtick-fenced MyST directives in docs/*.md

how to mark versionchanged in markdown docs
versionadded directive renders wrong in options docs
MyST directive syntax for version notes
note.body:
Symptom: "New in version X" / "Changed in version X" notices are missing or render wrongly on doc pages like docs/options.md.
Root cause: docs/options.md used the colon-fence form `:::{versionadded} 4.0` / `:::` with an empty body. This PR replaced every such use, so the docs build did not handle that form as intended.
Fix pattern: use the backtick-fence form, i.e. a line of ```` ```{versionadded} 4.0 ```` followed by a closing ```` ``` ```` line (the same goes for `{versionchanged}` and other directives). Put the explanatory prose after the directive, as normal text.
Constraints: applies to the MyST Markdown pages under docs/. When you add or edit version notes, copy the backtick form already used in docs/options.md rather than `:::`.
note.applies: Markdown (MyST) documentation files under docs/, especially version annotation directives
